newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot LPG prices stall at firm levels late.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot LPG prices stall at firm levels late.

text.p: U.S. spot LPG prices stalled at high levels late Friday, amid thin pre-weekend trade, industry sources said.
Trade faded as players left the market early or watched cautiously from sidelines as NYMEX slipped.
"It looks like we may be against a bit of a wall for the time being," one Kansas-based trader said.
Traders said the market remained in a "uptrend" from low inventories and Mexican demand. But buyers could put downward pressure on the market if they step out and wait for NYMEX to fall further.
Mont Belvieu propane was assessed at about 51 cents a gallon, while normal butane reportedly traded at 53.25 cents over. Purity ethane held at 32 cent a gallon, they said.
